method: Public career transactions and real courier delivery/collection ticks in isolated PhysX. Installed static collision geometry, receiving root, racks and forklift are copied. Carton positioning is explicit fixture setup; stock receipt, manifest checks and offsite payment use production methods.
scope: Transaction and physical-stock integration. Native mouse handling, rendered delivery animation and full forklift pallet transport need their separate browser and receiving checks. Future equipment balances are seeded only for threshold tests.

checks.name: empty opening and idempotent initialization
checks.expectation: The career opens with $600, no cartons, no truck cargo and no free racks, forklift or optional decoration.

checks.name: invalid and premature transactions preserve balances
checks.expectation: Unknown offers, locked suppliers, early equipment and missing stock cannot debit money or create promises.

checks.name: first purchase creates one identified batch
checks.expectation: Three physical tape cartons cost exactly $120 once; duplicate purchase, early order and inactive courier ticks leave balances and identities unchanged.

checks.name: receipt requires physical supported putaway
checks.expectation: Real courier delivery creates loose stock outside; suspended, kinematic and held cartons cannot count, and actual bay settling takes at least 0.45 seconds.

checks.name: exact physical manifest pays only offsite
checks.expectation: Missing or extra cartons block departure; acceptance and loading pay nothing; the actual completed route pays $210 exactly once and conserves all cartons.

checks.name: the carton business can repeat
checks.expectation: A second physical purchase, receipt and shipment completes without another unlock, reaching $780 after two tape orders.

checks.name: oldest physical carton IDs are reserved first
checks.expectation: Two purchased batches retain six unique sequence IDs and acceptance reserves the oldest three without paying.

checks.name: equipment unlock and working-cash reserve
checks.expectation: Racks and forklift require three orders and retain $120. Actual installed equipment becomes active once, and a pallet needs both purchases.

checks.name: physical pallet progression and dock pickup
checks.expectation: One paid pallet arrives on the real truck, must settle on the purchased rack before acceptance, reuses the docked delivery truck and pays only after physical reloading and offsite departure.

checks.name: missing equipment cannot consume money
checks.expectation: A missing rack or forklift root rejects the upgrade before debit.

checks.name: optional purchases charge once
checks.expectation: Fish and flame purchases create their real scene decoration once; flames require the forklift, and repeat requests leave money and ledger unchanged.

checks.name: insufficient working cash rejects stock
checks.expectation: A balance below the $120 tape purchase price cannot create cartons, queue a visit or debit money.
